name: XBO Intelligence
summary: XBO Intelligence is a Hefei developer of inspection robots, intelligent hardware and AI software for industrial environments. Founded in 2019, it supplies robotic monitoring and maintenance systems for mining and other infrastructure. Its portfolio includes the Luban S2 dual-arm humanoid, which combines mobile inspection with physical manipulation, alongside rail-mounted and wheeled inspection robots.
